sourceSummary: West Bromwich Albion 2026/27 post-window squad audit. Krystian Bielik, Alfie Gilchrist and Alex Mowatt are removed after their Cardiff, Leyton Orient and Derby moves; current West Brom players Brayann Pereira, Nolan Galves and Toby Collyer replace them one-for-one. Latest published market values and primary positions are retained separately from current-club evidence where databases lag summer transfers.
